comparison.objective: Stow an articulated light arm's clamp lever without moving the light.
comparison.physical_skill: Localized lever actuation while stabilizing an articulated mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp lever stowed and light pose preserved; body lacks motion and final-latch tolerances.
comparison.reason: Disturbance-free lever stowage tests constrained actuation, not hammer impact, sacrificial-part separation, or debris collection.
